verdict: Paid channels remain off; organic activity has also stalled this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, no spend ran on Meta or Google Ads, so all inbound activity came from your Google Business Profile and organic search. This past week, GBP engagement dropped to zero — a sharp reversal from the 136 actions recorded across the full 28-day window — and search clicks fell 32% versus the prior week, meaning organic inbound has effectively paused as well. Your CRM shows 24 contacts added this period but no appointments or pipeline movement, which tells us the intake process needs attention alongside the visibility issues. Resolving the outstanding agreement and CRM access items is the immediate priority that unlocks both paid reactivation and the automation needed to convert inbound contacts. Once those are in place, paid campaigns and GBP posting cadence are scheduled to resume by end of September.

highlights.phrase: Google Business Profile actions (calls, web clicks) received this 28-day period — the sole source of inbound before this week's drop
phone calls driven by your Google Business Profile in the last 28 days
paid ad spend across Meta and Google Ads for the entire 28-day window

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile engagement fell to zero this past week, cutting off the last active inbound channel.
watch_item.fix: A GBP posting cadence is being restored and is scheduled to be fully live by end of September, alongside a fix to the listing activity drop.
